id: 17_Replace the Welding Torch Communication Cable for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 激光焊接机焊枪通讯线的规范更换
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/17_Replace the Welding Torch Communication Cable for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/17_Replace the Welding Torch Communication Cable for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder/src.py

points.K14: 拔下通讯线，拆底壳螺钉
points.K16: 松开线卡，回形针作记号
points.K17: 从弹簧和护套抽出旧线
points.K19: 新线穿弹簧，接焊枪主板
points.K22: 按记号紧固线卡，取回形针
points.S3: 地面走线防碾压防绊倒

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台带前后把手的激光焊接机旁，手里举着焊枪，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a gray wheeled laser welding machine with handles at the front and back, holding up its handheld welding gun, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，看焊枪通讯线怎样更换。
overlay: 激光焊接机焊枪通讯线的规范更换

shots.scene: 焊枪、长线缆、主机三个图标用虚线连起
shots.prompt_en: Three icons joined by a dotted line: a handheld welding gun, a long coiled cable and a machine cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 焊枪的按键信号，全靠这根线传回主机。

shots.scene: 阿杰按焊枪上的按键，屏幕时有时无地跳出报警图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses the buttons on the welding gun while a warning icon flickers on and off on the machine screen.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现焊枪按键时灵时不灵。

shots.scene: 阿杰举起焊枪准备往台面上拍
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises the welding gun as if to bang it on the bench.
shots.narration: 他想拍两下焊枪试试。

shots.scene: 小研抓住他的手腕，老李走过来查看线缆
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student catches his wrist while the facility engineer comes over to inspect the gun cable.
shots.narration: 小研拦下，老李查出是通讯线坏了。

shots.scene: 拍打、甩动焊枪的两个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: a hand banging a welding gun on a table and a hand whipping the gun cable. No people.
shots.narration: 焊枪不能拍、线缆不能甩。

shots.scene: 焊枪头部激光出口旁边一个闪电和问号
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the welding gun nozzle with a lightning bolt and a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 信号乱了，可能误出光、关不住。

shots.scene: 阿杰按急停，拔插头，旁边空白报修单
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses the emergency stop, unplugs the machine and holds a blank repair form.
shots.narration: 按键失灵就停机断电，报修。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着黄黑边框警示卡，卡面只有闪电和人形打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a warning card with a yellow and black striped border, showing a lightning bolt icon and a crossed-out person icon.
shots.narration: 换线要拆机，只限专业人员。

shots.scene: 机箱剖面示意：一边闪电图标，一边激光束图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a machine cabinet with a lightning bolt icon on one side and a red laser beam icon on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 机内高压和强激光，会触电、烧伤。

shots.scene: 拔掉插头的焊机内部，一个模块上闪电图标，旁边沙漏
shots.prompt_en: Inside an unplugged machine cabinet, one module shows a glowing lightning bolt icon, with an hourglass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 断电后仍有残余高压，按说明书等待。

shots.scene: 老李戴上厚绝缘手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls on thick insulated gloves.
shots.narration: 全程戴好绝缘手套。

shots.scene: 工作台上摆着几把粗细不同的螺丝刀、内六角、剪刀、扎带、回形针和一卷新线
shots.prompt_en: On a workbench lie several screwdrivers of different sizes, a hex driver, scissors, cable ties, paper clips and a new coiled cable. No people.
shots.narration: 几种螺丝刀、内六角、剪刀和扎带。

shots.scene: 老李举起一枚回形针
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds up a single paper clip and smiles.
shots.narration: 还有回形针，待会儿做记号用。

shots.scene: 老李关机，拔下背面所有线缆
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the machine and unplugs all cables from the back.
shots.narration: 关机，拔掉所有线缆。

shots.scene: 老李踩下脚轮刹车
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake on a caster wheel with his foot.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮全部锁住。

shots.scene: 机器两端的把手连接处被虚线圈出，老李用内六角松螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The joints of the front and back handles are circled with dotted lines while the facility engineer loosens the screws with a hex driver.
shots.narration: 用内六角，松开前后把手八颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 老李拆下左侧盖上的螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screw on the left side cover.
shots.narration: 拆下左侧盖的螺钉。

shots.scene: 老李拆右侧盖螺钉，再从挂架上取下焊枪
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screws on the right side cover, then lifts the welding gun off its holder.
shots.narration: 拆右侧盖螺钉，取下焊枪。

shots.scene: 焊枪线缆在台面上盘成大弧度
shots.prompt_en: The welding gun cable is laid on the bench in wide gentle curves. No people.
shots.narration: 线缆别打急弯，保持挂着时的弧度。

shots.scene: 老李拆下焊枪挂架的三颗螺钉，取下挂架
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes three screws from the gun holder and takes it off.
shots.narration: 拆下挂架三颗螺钉，取下挂架。

shots.scene: 画面一角红箭头标出线缆夹的两颗螺钉
shots.prompt_en: A small inset with red arrows marks the two screws of the cable clamp as they are removed.
shots.narration: 再拆线缆夹的两颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 老李把右侧盖向上抬起，整块取下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the right side cover upward and takes it off completely.
shots.narration: 右侧盖向上抬，完全取下来。

shots.scene: 老李手持焊枪，用细梅花螺丝刀拆外壳螺钉，焊枪头部有激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds the welding gun and removes its shell screws with a fine star-tip screwdriver; a laser warning sign is on the gun head.
shots.narration: 用梅花刀，拆下焊枪外壳九颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 几种不同形状的小批头并排：十字、梅花、内六角
shots.prompt_en: Small screwdriver bits side by side: cross-head, star-shaped and hex. No people.
shots.narration: 小螺钉形状多，批头要选对型号。

shots.scene: 批头不匹配、螺钉滑丝的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a mismatched bit stripping a tiny screw head, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用错批头会滑丝，外壳装不牢。

shots.section_title: 拔下通讯线，拆底壳螺钉
shots.scene: 焊枪外壳打开，老李抬起接线插座拔下线
shots.prompt_en: The gun shell is opened and the facility engineer lifts a small connector latch and unplugs the cable.
shots.narration: 抬起插座，拔下通讯线。
overlay: 拔下通讯线，拆底壳螺钉

shots.section_title: 拔下通讯线，拆底壳螺钉
shots.scene: 细十字刀拆下底壳螺钉
shots.prompt_en: A fine cross-head screwdriver removes the screw on the bottom shell of the gun.
shots.narration: 再拆下底壳的螺钉。

shots.scene: 侧盖打开的机身里，老李用梅花刀拆线缆支架
shots.prompt_en: Inside the open machine side, the facility engineer removes a small cable bracket with a star-tip screwdriver.
shots.narration: 拆下机内的线缆支架。

shots.scene: 剪刀靠近一束线，只剪扎带不碰导线
shots.prompt_en: Scissors snip only a cable tie next to a bundle of wires without touching the wires.
shots.narration: 剪扎带时小心，别剪到其他线。

shots.section_title: 松开线卡，回形针作记号
shots.scene: 黑色线缆护套上四个线卡，老李逐个拧松
shots.prompt_en: Four clamps hold a black cable sleeve inside the machine; the facility engineer loosens them one by one.
shots.narration: 逐个松开护套上的四个线卡。
overlay: 松开线卡，回形针作记号

shots.section_title: 松开线卡，回形针作记号
shots.scene: 每个线卡位置插上一枚回形针
shots.prompt_en: A paper clip is inserted at each clamp position on the sleeve as a marker. No people.
shots.narration: 每个位置插一枚回形针作记号。

shots.section_title: 从弹簧和护套抽出旧线
shots.scene: 通讯线从弹簧和黑色护套里被抽出
shots.prompt_en: The communication cable is pulled out from inside a spring and the black sleeve.
shots.narration: 把旧线从弹簧和护套里抽出来。
overlay: 从弹簧和护套抽出旧线

shots.scene: 两人转动机器，老李从主板上拔下线的另一端
shots.prompt_en: Two people turn the machine around, and the facility engineer unplugs the other end of the cable from the main board.
shots.narration: 转动机器，拔下主板上的另一端。

shots.section_title: 新线穿弹簧，接焊枪主板
shots.scene: 新线穿过弹簧，接到焊枪内的小电路板
shots.prompt_en: The new cable is threaded through the spring and plugged into a small circuit board inside the gun end.
shots.narration: 新线穿过弹簧，接到焊枪主板。
overlay: 新线穿弹簧，接焊枪主板

shots.section_title: 新线穿弹簧，接焊枪主板
shots.scene: 线缆支架拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The cable bracket is screwed back in place.
shots.narration: 装回线缆支架。

shots.scene: 线缆被慢慢塞进黑色护套，直到看不见
shots.prompt_en: The cable is gradually pushed into the black sleeve until it is fully covered.
shots.narration: 线塞进黑色护套，直到完全包住。

shots.scene: 线头穿过右侧盖的过孔，转到机器另一侧插到主板
shots.prompt_en: The cable end is routed through a hole in the right cover and plugged into the main board on the other side of the machine.
shots.narration: 穿过右侧盖，另一端插回主板。

shots.section_title: 按记号紧固线卡，取回形针
shots.scene: 老李对着回形针的位置拧紧线卡
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tightens each clamp exactly where a paper clip marks the position.
shots.narration: 对着回形针记号，逐个拧紧线卡。
overlay: 按记号紧固线卡，取回形针

shots.section_title: 按记号紧固线卡，取回形针
shots.scene: 回形针全部取下放回盒里
shots.prompt_en: All the paper clips are removed and dropped back into a small box.
shots.narration: 拧好后，回形针一个不落取下来。

shots.scene: 焊枪底壳螺钉装回，线接回原位
shots.prompt_en: The bottom shell screw of the gun is refitted and the wire is reconnected to its original position.
shots.narration: 装回底壳螺钉，线接回原位。

shots.scene: 老李轻拉导线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer gently tugs the wire to check it.
shots.narration: 轻拉一下，确认接牢。

shots.scene: 顶盖合上前，手指把护套里的弹簧推到位
shots.prompt_en: Before closing the top cover, a finger pushes the spring inside the black sleeve into its seat.
shots.narration: 装顶盖前，确认护套里的弹簧到位。

shots.scene: 上下壳螺钉逐颗拧紧
shots.prompt_en: All screws on the top and bottom shells of the gun are tightened one by one.
shots.narration: 上下壳的螺钉全部拧紧。

shots.scene: 右侧盖装回，线缆夹和挂架螺钉拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The right cover is refitted, and the screws of the cable clamp and the gun holder are tightened.
shots.narration: 装回右侧盖、线缆夹和挂架。

shots.scene: 焊枪放回挂架，侧盖螺钉装回
shots.prompt_en: The welding gun is placed back into its holder and the right cover screw is refitted.
shots.narration: 焊枪放回挂架，装好螺钉。

shots.scene: 左侧盖两边的挂钩对准机架上的销钉，推进去
shots.prompt_en: The hooks on both sides of the left cover are aligned with pegs on the frame and the cover is pushed in.
shots.narration: 左侧盖挂钩对准销钉，推进去。

shots.scene: 拧紧左侧盖螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The screw securing the left cover is tightened.
shots.narration: 拧紧螺钉固定。

shots.scene: 两端把手装回，每侧四颗螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The front and back handles are refitted with four screws on each side.
shots.narration: 装回把手，两侧各四颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 老李用力摇一摇把手，确认不松动
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer firmly shakes each handle to check that it does not wobble.
shots.narration: 把手是搬运受力点，摇一摇不晃才行。

shots.scene: 把手松脱、机器砸地的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a loose handle coming off and a machine falling onto the floor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 螺钉没拧紧就推拉，机器会脱手。

shots.scene: 阿杰沿着焊枪线缆从头到尾摸一遍
shots.prompt_en: The young male student runs his hand along the welding gun cable from end to end.
shots.narration: 每次用前，顺着线缆摸一遍。

shots.scene: 线缆破皮、压扁、弹簧外露三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three warning icons: a cable with a torn jacket, a flattened cable and a cable with its inner spring sticking out. No people.
shots.narration: 破皮、压扁、弹簧外露，都要停用。

shots.section_title: 地面走线防碾压防绊倒
shots.scene: 推车轮子压过地上焊枪线缆、人被线绊倒两个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: a cart wheel rolling over a gun cable on the floor and a person tripping over a cable. No people.
shots.narration: 线缆别横在过道上。
overlay: 地面走线防碾压防绊倒

shots.section_title: 地面走线防碾压防绊倒
shots.scene: 线缆沿墙边走，用盖板盖住
shots.prompt_en: The gun cable runs along the wall edge under a flat cable cover. No people.
shots.narration: 沿墙走或加盖板，防压防绊。

shots.scene: 小研焊完，把焊枪挂回挂架
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student finishes welding and hangs the gun back on its holder.
shots.narration: 焊枪用完挂回挂架。

shots.scene: 焊枪放在地上、放在工件上两个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: a welding gun lying on the floor and a welding gun resting on a workpiece. No people.
shots.narration: 放地上会摔坏，压到扳机会误出光。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊机旁，身后浮现四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the laser welding machine with four icons behind: a crossed-out hand banging, a cable check, a cable cover and a gun on a holder.
shots.narration: 故障不拍打，线缆常检查。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 走线防绊倒，焊枪挂好，把手拧紧。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李、小研和阿杰在焊机前挥手，焊枪挂在挂架上
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye beside the machine with its gun hung on the holder.
shots.narration: 一根线连着手和光，要护好。下次见！
